name: squash_unrelated_push_to_a_file_both_changed
description: Q5-A01: the open PR changes only CHANGELOG.md, the base changed it too since the PR branched, and someone pushes an unrelated edit of the same file to the base. The tree-level rule cannot tell that from a squash git combined, so it says squash with CHANGELOG.md in combined: readers must present combined paths as not checked for the PR's change, and the web offers no 'Record merge' for it.
